verdict.rationale: Groq's evidence covers inference APIs: chat, tool use, remote MCP, batch, service tiers and structured outputs. None of it documents user-defined rules that fire actions automatically when events occur. Spend limits with budget alerts are a narrow billing control rather than a general event-rule engine, and model tool calling is an adjacent feature, so neither earns credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events
